rationale: P identifies the braking behavior that must be characterised to determine whether required braking maneuvers are omitted. This behavior is explicitly established by SG-1 and FR-7, rather than included merely as a mechanism affecting another phenomenon. H-1 and the general collision-avoidance requirement support the pedestrian scenario and analogous obstacle cases. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure-management mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: “The vehicle’s braking behavior” directly concerns the behavior required by SG-1 and FR-7.
“In situations where braking is required to avoid collision” ties the phenomenon to the evaluation target and H-1’s collision hazard.
The scope includes the stated pedestrian-crossing scenario and analogous obstacle-avoidance cases, supported by H-1’s road-user/static-obstacle coverage and FR-7.
The on-or-near-trajectory scope is conditioned on a possible need for collision-avoidance braking and is supported by FR-7.2.4’s treatment of objects on or close to the trajectory.
